content.text: {"answer":"40","citations":["D039","D038","D008","D114"],"explanation":"The signed renewal order form, executed 2026-02-24 and effective 2026-03-01, sets Thornbury Cloth Co. (formerly Orrin Mills) at 40 subscribed seats at USD 1,700 per seat per year. The earlier 44-seat version was never countersigned, and the account record and the April weekly update both confirm 40 seats."}
